dslRule:
<!id: add-null-check-field-comparison>
<!description: Add null check for object field before comparison to prevent NullPointerException.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: null-safety, defensive-coding>

$field == $session :: isField($field) && instanceof($field, "java.lang.Object")
=>
$field != null && $field == $session
;;
